core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hafeez corresponds to the Arabic form حفيظ (Arabic root ح ف ظ (ḥ-f-ẓ); حفيظ (Ḥafīẓ)). Its core sense is protector, guardian, preserver. The source gloss 'guardian, custodian' is correct.
